_note: A long operations conversation with things the user establishes early and later questions that depend on them. Written by the module's author, so treat the results as a regression check of the strategies, not an evaluation of any model. Every probe names the one earlier exchange it needs. A probe is recalled when the text it needs ("needs") is in the context, whether verbatim or in a summary.

facts.assistant: 4 P1 incidents in ELEV created 2026-09-01 to 2026-09-30: ELEV-31, ELEV-33, ELEV-34, ELEV-36.
facts.probe: Remind me, what was the September P1 number for ELEV?

facts.user: Which work orders are open on escalator ESC-127-02?
facts.assistant: One: WO-1001, step chain noise at the lower landing, opened 2026-10-09.
facts.probe: Is WO-1001 on ESC-127-02 still the only open one?

facts.user: When is the v1 count API retired?
facts.assistant: v1 is deprecated and its sunset is 31 January 2027; after that it returns 410 and points to v2.
facts.probe: When does the v1 count API go away again?

facts.user: From now on, only count incidents for Signals unless I say otherwise.
facts.assistant: Understood: counts will be for SIG until you say otherwise.
facts.probe: How many open incidents were created this week?

facts.user: Always show me the JQL with every answer.
facts.assistant: Will do: every count will include its JQL.

facts.user: I work nights, so today for me means since 7 pm yesterday.
facts.assistant: Got it: for you, today starts at 19:00 the previous day.
facts.probe: How many incidents came in today?
